about: Tools Shopproof offers to a shop owner's AI assistant over MCP (decision 0047). Every platform offers exactly these names and inputs; each plugin keeps a copy and a test keeps the copies equal. Edit here, then copy.

tools.name: get_setup_status
tools.title: Setup status
tools.description: What Shopproof has set up in this shop, what is still missing and what needs the owner. Start here. Technical help, not legal advice.

tools.name: list_settings
tools.title: List settings
tools.description: Every Shopproof setting the assistant may read or change, with its current value, the allowed values, a plain description and whether shoppers see it.

tools.name: recommend_settings
tools.title: Recommended switches
tools.description: The features this shop's own facts call for (country, products, taxes, shipping, payments) that are still off. Pass their keys to preview_change as switch_on.

tools.name: preview_change
tools.title: Preview a change
tools.description: Checks a change and says in plain words what would change and what shoppers would see. Nothing is saved. Show the preview to the owner, then call apply_change with its preview_code once they agree.

settings.description: Setting keys from list_settings with their new values.

create_withdrawal_page.description: Create and publish the page with the withdrawal form.

tools.name: apply_change
tools.title: Apply a previewed change
tools.description: Saves a change the owner agreed to, using the preview_code from preview_change. Works only when the owner has turned on Allow changes. Every change is recorded and can be undone with undo_change.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.title: Changes made by assistants
tools.description: The latest changes made through an AI assistant, newest first, with what changed and whether they were undone.

tools.name: undo_change
tools.title: Undo a change
tools.description: Puts back the values from before one change. Settings changed since by someone else stay as they are.

tools.name: list_withdrawals
tools.title: Withdrawals
tools.description: Withdrawal requests, newest first, with their state, deadline and refund clock. Customer names and emails are hidden unless the owner turned on Include customer details.

tools.name: get_withdrawal
tools.title: One withdrawal
tools.description: One withdrawal request by its reference, with items, dates and refund clock. Customer details only with Include customer details on.

tools.name: proof_log
tools.title: Proof log
tools.description: The latest entries of the shop's tamper-evident proof log and whether the chain checks out. Entries hold no direct customer identifiers.
